_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Leikari Surround á einum {width}x{height} gríd.
Tú ert leikari {player_id}. Gildigir leikir: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' eller w/s/a/d.
Áseting: yvirliva alla aðra. Trailir eru deyðiligir; veggahit killa; háloftkollvel killa báðar.

game_action.invalid_death: Leikarin {player_id} doyði orsakað av ógildu gongdini.

outcome.survived_win: Leikarurin {player_id} yvirlivdi; allir hinir datt niður.
outcome.all_crashed: Allir leikararnir fóru at fella samstundis.
outcome.outlived: Player livdi longur enn allir hinir.
outcome.turn_limit: Um tú hevur rokkið umstøðurnar, vinnur tann sum livir longst.
